title: WF03 Stage11 testfix: SIM compile blockers, XC shim server errors, and OIDC-35 compensation leak/failure cluster
summary: Resolved the reported WF03 Stage11 blocker/major cluster by fixing SIM compile defects, hardening compatibility shim behavior across mixed integration schemas, and correcting OIDC-35 compensation cleanup and leak paths. Focused validation now passes for XC-03/04/05/06 and OIDC-35 suites.

root_cause.details: The SIM suite failed to compile because tenant_store parsed hex nibbles without unwrapping error unions and uuid_source used Zig 0.16-incompatible writeInt slice typing. XC suites failed because applyCompatibilityShims assumed stable legacy function/trigger state and hard-failed on server-side schema variance. OIDC-35-07 failures combined missing deterministic cleanup guarantees on realm provisioning failure with tenant materialization/query row leak paths under debug allocator checks.

changes: Fixed SIM parser and deterministic UUID source compile regressions for Zig 0.16 compatibility.
Made integration compatibility shims resilient to server-side incompatibility by dropping/recreating legacy shim functions and treating shim SQL server errors as best-effort compatibility events.
Updated OIDC-35 saga to explicitly invoke compensation on realm provisioning failures and improved tenant cleanup path robustness.
Fixed onboarding tenant creation row-allocation leak and XC-01 test allocation leak.
Made SIM-01 event type registration unique per test run to avoid cross-suite duplicate event type collisions.

prevention: Use explicit try-unwrapping when composing bit operations over error-union nibble parsers in deterministic identifier code paths.
Keep integration compatibility shims best-effort and resilient to heterogeneous schema states rather than treating shim DDL as hard requirements.
Ensure saga failure branches execute compensation explicitly for external provider failures and free intermediate DB row allocations before returning.
